strategy_version_author_valid.name: strategy_version_author_valid
strategy_version_author_valid.value: "strategy_versions"."job_id" is not null or "strategy_versions"."created_by" is not null

ledger_deltas_valid.name: ledger_deltas_valid
ledger_deltas_valid.value:
(
    ("usage_ledger"."type" in ('GRANT','PURCHASE','REFUND') and "usage_ledger"."amount" > 0 and "usage_ledger"."available_delta" = "usage_ledger"."amount" and "usage_ledger"."reserved_delta" = 0 and "usage_ledger"."reservation_id" is null) or
    ("usage_ledger"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' and "usage_ledger"."amount" <> 0 and "usage_ledger"."available_delta" = "usage_ledger"."amount" and "usage_ledger"."reserved_delta" = 0 and "usage_ledger"."reservation_id" is null) or
    ("usage_ledger"."type" = 'EXPIRE' and "usage_ledger"."amount" > 0 and "usage_ledger"."available_delta" = -"usage_ledger"."amount" and "usage_ledger"."reserved_delta" = 0 and "usage_ledger"."reservation_id" is null) or
    ("usage_ledger"."type" = 'RESERVE' and "usage_ledger"."amount" > 0 and "usage_ledger"."available_delta" = -"usage_ledger"."amount" and "usage_ledger"."reserved_delta" = "usage_ledger"."amount" and "usage_ledger"."reservation_id" is not null) or
    ("usage_ledger"."type" = 'CAPTURE' and "usage_ledger"."amount" > 0 and "usage_ledger"."available_delta" = 0 and "usage_ledger"."reserved_delta" = -"usage_ledger"."amount" and "usage_ledger"."reservation_id" is not null) or
    ("usage_ledger"."type" = 'RELEASE' and "usage_ledger"."amount" > 0 and "usage_ledger"."available_delta" = "usage_ledger"."amount" and "usage_ledger"."reserved_delta" = -"usage_ledger"."amount" and "usage_ledger"."reservation_id" is not null))

consent_revocation_valid.name: consent_revocation_valid
consent_revocation_valid.value: ("consent_records"."revoked_at" is null and "consent_records"."revoked_by_user_id" is null) or ("consent_records"."revoked_at" >= "consent_records"."accepted_at" and "consent_records"."revoked_by_user_id" is not null)

media_photo_valid.name: media_photo_valid
media_photo_valid.value: "media_assets"."kind" = 'PHOTO' and "media_assets"."mime_type" = 'image/jpeg' and "media_assets"."bytes" between 1 and 3145728 and "media_assets"."width" between 1 and 2048 and "media_assets"."height" between 1 and 2048

social_credential_required.name: social_credential_required
social_credential_required.value: ("social_connections"."status" = 'REVOKED' and "social_connections"."credential" is null) or ("social_connections"."status" <> 'REVOKED' and "social_connections"."credential" is not null)

recommendation_decision_valid.name: recommendation_decision_valid
recommendation_decision_valid.value: ("strategy_recommendation_decisions"."decision" = 'ACCEPTED' and "strategy_recommendation_decisions"."applied_version" is not null) or ("strategy_recommendation_decisions"."decision" = 'REJECTED' and "strategy_recommendation_decisions"."applied_version" is null)

billing_order_amount_valid.name: billing_order_amount_valid
billing_order_amount_valid.value: "billing_orders"."amount_minor" between 1 and 1000000000 and "billing_orders"."currency" = 'RUB' and "billing_orders"."ai_credits" between 0 and 1000000000 and "billing_orders"."video_seconds" between 0 and 1000000000

billing_order_renewal_valid.name: billing_order_renewal_valid
billing_order_renewal_valid.value: (("billing_orders"."renewal_consent_id" is null and "billing_orders"."renewal_revision" is null and "billing_orders"."input"->>'saveMethod' = 'false') or ("billing_orders"."renewal_consent_id" is not null and "billing_orders"."renewal_revision" > 0 and ("billing_orders"."input"->>'saveMethod' = 'true' or "billing_orders"."input"->>'mode' = 'RENEWAL'))) IS TRUE

payment_method_revocation_valid.name: payment_method_revocation_valid
payment_method_revocation_valid.value: ("billing_payment_methods"."revoked_at" is null and "billing_payment_methods"."credential" is not null) or ("billing_payment_methods"."revoked_at" is not null and "billing_payment_methods"."credential" is null)

plan_version_valid.name: plan_version_valid
plan_version_valid.value: "plan_versions"."version" > 0 and "plan_versions"."amount_minor" between 0 and 1000000000 and "plan_versions"."currency" = 'RUB' and "plan_versions"."ai_credits" between 0 and 1000000000 and "plan_versions"."video_seconds" between 0 and 1000000000

renewal_change_valid.name: renewal_change_valid
renewal_change_valid.value: "billing_renewal_changes"."revision" > 0 and "billing_renewal_changes"."operation" in ('ENABLE','DISABLE') and ("billing_renewal_changes"."operation" <> 'ENABLE' or "billing_renewal_changes"."consent_id" is not null)

subscription_term_period_valid.name: subscription_term_period_valid
subscription_term_period_valid.value: "subscription_terms"."month_index" between 1 and 1200 and "subscription_terms"."ends_at" > "subscription_terms"."starts_at" and "subscription_terms"."starts_at" = (("subscription_terms"."anchor_at" at time zone 'UTC') + make_interval(months => "subscription_terms"."month_index" - 1)) at time zone 'UTC' and "subscription_terms"."ends_at" = (("subscription_terms"."anchor_at" at time zone 'UTC') + make_interval(months => "subscription_terms"."month_index")) at time zone 'UTC'

payment_task_attempt_valid.name: payment_task_attempt_valid
payment_task_attempt_valid.value: "payment_tasks"."attempt" >= 0 and "payment_tasks"."submission_count" >= 0 and (("payment_tasks"."first_submitted_at" is null and "payment_tasks"."submission_count" = 0) or ("payment_tasks"."first_submitted_at" is not null and "payment_tasks"."submission_count" > 0))

payment_task_lease_valid.name: payment_task_lease_valid
payment_task_lease_valid.value: ("payment_tasks"."status" = 'RUNNING' and "payment_tasks"."lease_token" is not null and "payment_tasks"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("payment_tasks"."status" <> 'RUNNING' and "payment_tasks"."lease_token" is null and "payment_tasks"."lease_expires_at" is null)

webhook_lease_valid.name: webhook_lease_valid
webhook_lease_valid.value: ("webhook_events"."status" = 'PROCESSING' and "webhook_events"."lease_token" is not null and "webhook_events"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("webhook_events"."status" <> 'PROCESSING' and "webhook_events"."lease_token" is null and "webhook_events"."lease_expires_at" is null)

email_lease_valid.name: email_lease_valid
email_lease_valid.value: ("email_outbox"."status"='SENDING') = ("email_outbox"."lease_token" is not null and "email_outbox"."lease_until" is not null)

team_invitation_state_valid.name: team_invitation_state_valid
team_invitation_state_valid.value: ("team_invitations"."accepted_at" is null) = ("team_invitations"."accepted_by" is null) and not ("team_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "team_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null) and (("team_invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "team_invitations"."revoked_at" is null) = ("team_invitations"."encrypted_token" is not null))

account_deletion_state_valid.name: account_deletion_state_valid
account_deletion_state_valid.value: ("account_deletion_requests"."status" = 'REQUESTED' and "account_deletion_requests"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("account_deletion_requests"."status" = 'CANCELLED' and "account_deletion_requests"."cancelled_at" is not null and "account_deletion_requests"."cancelled_at" >= "account_deletion_requests"."created_at")
